build_method: Exact game main Git archive with an isolated localhost Go API and Vite frontend. Official QA checkpoints and normal inputs in a private guest save. No game rules or save contents edited.
cast_timing: Active cats charge at 5 energy per battle second to 100 when not blocked. Star Burst uses targeting; Shield and Healing Purr cast on selection. The engine applies effects on acceptance, then the viewport emits the 2.2 s cast banner and 1.8 s board feedback. There is no distinct pre-release wind-up in this build. Each recording includes the full shipped cast sequence.

event.trigger: Fixed node encounter with genuine randomized dice outcome
event.continuity: Same isolated QA save through genuine choice, unforced roll and battle. No reset or save edit between choice and battle. Material +2 is inventory, separate from the modifier.

local_masters: Original game screenshots and timestamped browser frames retained outside Git. The Warehouse and Tunnel clips preserve actual frame times at normal gameplay speed.

sound_recapture.capture: One Chrome MediaRecorder capture per cast, from the isolated game tab video and application audio tracks. 1600 × 900 at normal speed. Background music and ambient mix set to zero in the guest browser. H.264/AAC 1280 × 720, mono 48 kHz. Full frame, no audio substitution, added cues, time scaling or system/microphone capture. Raw recordings retained locally.
